author: mikeyk
text: 2 years ago, I met Charles, who learned to code while incarcerated and was looking for a role in tech after leaving prison. He joined @slackHQ, who are sharing their blueprint for the apprenticeship program he did (and graduated from!). thanks to @stewart and team for sharing

quoted.text:
A highlight of 2019 was the success of Jesse, Lino & Charles, the first three people going through Next Chapter. I am so proud of these men, and the support shown by the whole company. 🙇

In this post: blueprint doc download for other orgs to try + video: https://t.co/TeAFpuQrZj

author: mikeyk
text:
Is there a contacts app/manager that can:
- handle people as both individuals and part of a couple?
- let couples share a mailing address but each have their own email
- easily export to CSV?

I end up reinventing this every year with a combination of Sheets & Python scripts...
